meta.description:
Cartoonist Aritra’s life turns upside down when mysterious things start happening in his new apartment. Mayhem ensues when a paranormal activist dies suddenly.

videos.title: Stranger Things
videos.overview: The housewarming party of cartoonist Aritra and his girlfriend Jinia's new flat ends up in a nightmare when Aritra notices strange activities all around.

videos.title: The Blank pages
videos.overview: The plot thickens when Aritra's boss receives blank pages from him in the mail instead of finished cartoons, leaving Aritra clueless and shocked.

videos.title: The Disorder
videos.overview: Aritra feels he is suffering from a hallucinating disorder. As the strange occurrences continue, he becomes restless and even has a panic attack.

videos.title: When you were young
videos.overview: Jinia convinces Aritra to visit paranormal activist Rathikantababu to find out the strange happenings in their apartment, he suspects the presence of a spirit.

videos.title: Dead of the night
videos.overview: Aritra visits their landlord with queries on his mind. Rathikanta suggests Jinia to leave the place as early as possible.

videos.title: The Death
videos.overview: Situations worsen when Rathikantababu dies mysteriously in Aritra's house. Aritra becomes the prime suspect.

videos.title: The Missing Link
videos.overview: Jinia tries to look for answers to the mysteries when she comes across a shocking revelation.
